digest.component_or_area: DC sub-task parent synchronization (rebar outbound/inbound reconciler)
propositions: DC silently ignores PUT fields.parent on a sub-task (accept-and-ignore), making sub-task parent sync unrepresentable on the platform; the supported mechanism is Epic Link on non-sub-task children

rebar's emit-side parent suppression for non-epic parents returns (False, None) indistinguishably from 'unbound, retry later', so unsupported parent edits exit the pass with convergence=true and never reach record_parent_divergence, leaving operator-visible divergence invisible

Three live cells that never passed in 12 consecutive harness runs (test_inbound_set_subtask_parent_round_trips, test_outbound_set_subtask_parent_round_trips, test_outbound_clear_parent_round_trips) were wrong oracles asserting operations the platform cannot perform, not symptoms of the rebar defect

Acceptance criteria require: making emit-side suppression loud with durable bridge alert, re-homing inbound/outbound cells to Epic Link mechanism while preserving subject assertions, keeping sub-task refusal pinned, and verifying all green in live harness run without deleting/skipping/xfailing any cell

Changes 1399 and 1400 landed; live run 30964805133 verified all three cells PASSED (first fully-green harness run in 12-run window); emit-time recording now conditional on divergence from remote snapshot to avoid spurious alerts on converged parents
